note: Test keys derived from the public text castbridge-journal-vectors-v1|<name> (seed = SHA-256 of that text). Entry hash h(n) = SHA-256(h(n-1) + '|' + entry line), h(0) = 64 zeros. Never a real key.

cases.name: valid-batch-every-entry-type
cases.why: one batch with an entry of each of the eight types

cases.name: two-chained-batches
cases.why: the second batch continues the chain: prev is the last hash of the first

cases.name: replay-same-batch
cases.why: the same signed batch sent twice changes nothing

cases.name: gap-between-batches
cases.why: entries 3 and 4 were never received: the later batch is kept and the hole is reported

cases.name: gap-filled-later
cases.why: the missing batch arrives afterwards and fills the hole

cases.name: rewritten-entry
cases.why: same entry number, different content: the batch goes to quarantine

cases.name: prev-mismatch
cases.why: the batch claims to follow another entry than the last one known: quarantine

cases.name: unknown-key
cases.why: signed by a key outside the ring of the server

cases.name: revoked-key
cases.why: signed by a trusted key that has been revoked

cases.name: bad-signature
cases.why: one bit of the signature flipped

cases.name: batch-number-goes-back
cases.why: new entries under a batch number lower than the last accepted one are refused

cases.name: entry-numbers-not-dense
cases.why: entry numbers 1 then 3 inside one batch

cases.name: not-a-journal
cases.why: an activation envelope is not a journal

cases.name: more-than-500-entries
cases.why: a batch holds at most 500 entries
